data.title: The Spring Update is Live: Play Today!
data.summary: Check out all the new content
data.content:
Grow your power in the Spring Update, now live in War Robots: Frontiers. Update your game to the latest version on MY.GAMES Launcher or Steam. Until April 10, it’s Pioneer Pack owners only on the Wild Ten, but new Pilots can join the fray and play for free from April 11 to May 2! 

Check out the patch notes for a full list of new features and changes in the Spring Update!

PROGRESS WIPE & REWARDS

As of the release of the Spring Update, all accounts have now been wiped so everyone can begin their experience on equal footing. Pioneer Pack owners will be able to jump back into the Spring Update straight away with exclusive Early Access until April 10. 

All Pioneer Pack owners have now been sent a Resource Pack to thank them for their invaluable testing over the past months, and to help rebuild their Hangar and swiftly jump back in the cockpit:

Check out the full FAQ here for more detailed information. If you need help recovering items, please click here. 

PILOT TWO NEW ROBOTS

Two new formidable friends are joining your Hangar with the Spring Update. Meet Orochi and Purifier. 

Orochi

Orochi is a scouting Robot built for speed and reconnaissance. Orochi highlights enemies, pings them, and prepares for a team fight with its allies. Its ability, Spotlight, enables a speed boost and allows allied weapons to lock on to highlighted enemies.

Purifier 

Purifier is the best bodyguard for your team. A heavy, slow-moving Robot, Purifier keeps its allies close, buffing them as they head into battle. Its ability, Zealot, buffs surrounding allies, enabling them to deal increased damage. This damage bonus increased with every enemy shield penetrated and Robot destroyed. 

BATTLE ON A NEW MAP: CATALYST

This volcanic Map isn’t for the faint of heart. Available across all three game modes, Catalyst is an explosive experience where lava can take you out just as fast as a foe. 

UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL

Two new Weapons and a brand-new Ability are yours to wield in the Spring Update. Slow enemies and inflict damage with the new Minefield Ability, sure to shock unsuspecting enemies.

Burn up the competition with the new flamethrower Incinerator, and cause major AoE damage with the Rampant light grenade launcher. 

EXPERIMENT AT THE FIRING RANGE

Test out your Robot and Titan builds on the new Firing Range! Battle against static Robots and aggressive AI to make sure you’re operating at the highest levels of power possible. 

POWER UP YOUR TITANS

Titans are the most powerful tool you have on the battlefield, and now you can upgrade and customize your fearsome friends in the new Titan Constructor. Outfit your newly leveled Titans with brand-new Weapons. 

  • Bayonet (Alpha): This electromagnetic medium-range pulse laser packs a shocking punch. 
  • Jigsaw (Grim): Fire a blade projectile that can ricochet from surfaces and tear into enemy targets.
  • Scrubber (Matriarch): A pair of multi-barrel machine guns will wipe out the competition.

COMMUNITY EVENTS

Celebrate the Spring Update with our Firing Range: Titan Arena Community Event! Enter the Firing Range, summon the Alpha Titan, destroy it, and share your best kill times on Discord until April 10. 

The top three players will receive special rewards, including Intel, Discord roles, emojis, and stickers. Check Discord for all the details!

Note: Rewards are subject to future Progress Wipes. 

JOIN THE WAR ROBOTS COMMUNITY!

Subscribe to the official newsletter to get more of the latest news like this straight to your inbox, follow the game on Twitter and Facebook, and join the official Discord server. You can also wishlist and follow War Robots: Frontiers on Steam to get the latest news there.

IMPORTANT: War Robots: Frontiers is now available to play in Early Access, and the game is currently in a Closed Beta phase. Development is ongoing and content is subject to change and improvement based on player feedback before the game's full release.
